planned.identity: One rescue worker in a matte yellow storm suit and plain white helmet.
planned.wardrobe_props: Red rigid emergency case with two silver latches; black strap caught by the worker's left hand; black safety line at the waist.
planned.space_direction: Worker and case slide screen-right toward the railing; safety anchor remains upper-left beside blue containers.
planned.motion: Worker ends on the right knee with left fingertips on the strap while the line becomes taut.
planned.light_material: Cold overhead blue work lights, rain-slick steel, one distant lightning exposure.
planned.story_beat: The worker catches the case strap before either the case or the sliding body has stopped.

grammar.narrative_moment: End on first contact with the strap, before the rescue outcome is known.
grammar.camera_movement: Low medium-wide fixed witness position beside a stable container row; absorb ship roll without an impossible floating camera.
grammar.light_color: Cold practical work lights remain fixed; a distant lightning pulse reveals rain without moving the source.
grammar.space_composition: Blue containers anchor upper-left depth; worker and case travel screen-right toward a visible low railing.
grammar.material_physics: Deck water flows downhill, the rigid case slides with mass, and the safety line arrests the body only after becoming taut.
